newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in range after recovery on Japanese buying.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in range after recovery on Japanese buying.

text.p: The ringgit remained confined to a narrow trading range after recovering from midsession selling pressures on fresh Japanese fund buying, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said U.S. funds, anticipating some ringgit buying, had bought dollars in the morning. Once the Japanese came in, the U.S. funds sold.
"There was big business done between 2.4770 and 2.4790," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
"Now it is an equal buyers and sellers situation," he said.
"The U.S funds which had come in were basically for intraday trade. The ringgit should gain some more," said a dealer with a U.S. bank in Singapore.
Dealers said there was little impact of the dollar's fall against yen on the ringgit.
"But, if the dollar/yen continues to slide below 122, then Malaysian corporate buyers may step in to buy dollars," said a dealer with another Malaysian bank.
He said the market was on the whole still short dollars.
At 0800 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4770/77 a dollar.
